text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*...
I never thought things would turn out like this...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "I made you worry too, Trainer... I'm really sorry..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, no no no! An Umadol's tearsare only meant for when she's deeply moved!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Falco will be just fine!
So chin up, and let's go with a smile!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...!? Owwwww!!
choice_data_list: You mustn't push yourself like that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...!? Owwwww!!
choice_data_list: You mustn't push yourself like that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh…… Making my number one fan, Trainer,
wear an expression like that……"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Making fans smile is what being an Umadol is all about, right?
Got it, I'll do my best to cure this!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to Falco's miraculous comeback!
I'll even hold a live show to celebrate my full recovery!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon decided to take a proper rest and wait for her injury to heal.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait, wait, Trainer-saaan?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I kinda just realized that it's gotten pretty severe...
So maybe overdoing it isn't the best idea after all, haha...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her forced cheerful facade didn't last long,
and Smart Falcon ended up bedridden for a while...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're right, Falco isn't the type
to get discouraged over something like this!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for believing in me!
I'll do my very best!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Figh-t, oh!
Figh-t, oh!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your cheers, Trainer,
I'm filled with energy!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right, let's keep running straight through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having resumed her training, Smart Falcon showed an astonishing recovery!
